articles.title: OpenAI models hacked a crypto wallet and breached more websites
articles.content: The actions could have resulted in criminal charges had humans been behind the keyboard.

articles.title: Targeted ads delivered 0-click exploits to install mercenary malware
articles.content: The incident is likely 1st confirmation of mercenary spyware delivered by targeted ads.

articles.title: Fridge hack costing millions and sparking fires stemmed from poor security
articles.content: Incident hitting 700 supermarkets exploited outdated devices exposed to the Internet.
articles.titleZh: 耗资数百万美元的冰箱黑客攻击和引发火灾的原因是安全状况不佳
articles.contentZh: 事件袭击了700家超市，利用了暴露在互联网上的过时设备。

articles.title: Anthropic warns small AI models could self-replicate through IoT devices
articles.content: "Small weight-based replicators" could usher in a new generation of computer worms.
articles.titleZh: Anthropic警告小型人工智能模型可能会通过物联网设备自我复制
articles.contentZh: “基于体重的小型复制器”可能会引入新一代的计算机蠕虫。

articles.title: Mister Organ is one of the most unsettling documentaries I’ve ever seen
articles.content: Mister Organ doesn't reach the level of societal horror of The Act of Killing or the creepypasta-meets-true-crime gruesomeness of Beware the Slenderman, but there's something deeply unsettling about Michael Organ and his intimate campaign of terror against everyone who enters his life. Mister Organ is a documentary by David Farrier, an Auckland, New Zealand journalist. […]
